beats.title: 5 things I wish I knew about *short-form video*
The hook is the first *1.5 seconds*
beats.text: Lead with the payoff, not the intro.

beats.title: Keep text out of the *bottom third*
beats.text: Captions and buttons cover it on every app.

beats.title: Design for *sound off*
beats.text: Most people watch muted. Captions carry the story.

beats.title: Render it, don't *edit* it
beats.text: A spec file is easier to fix than a timeline.
